section_summary.extract_value: This section describes use of the 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) to assess body appreciation; items were rated 1 (Never) to 5 (Always) and an overall mean score was computed, with higher scores indicating greater body appreciation. The authors note prior psychometric support for the BAS-2 in college and community US samples and report internal consistency in the present study (Cronbach's α = .95 for women, .96 for men).
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants completed the 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2; Tylka&Wood-Barcalow,2015b), which assesses acceptance of one's body, respect and care for one's body, and protection of one's body from unrealistic beauty standards (sample item: ''I respect my body''). All items were rated on a 5-point scale, ranging from 1 (Never)to 5 (Always), and an overall score was computed as the mean of all items, such that higher scores reflect greater body appreciation. In the present study, Cronbach's a for this scale was .95 in women and .96 in men.
